cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings passes clean.

reproductive_readiness_factors() computes all 8 named factors: temperature, condition, minerals, stability, molt_stress, density, tan, nitrite — each backed by species parameters in neocaridina_davidi.toml and ShrimpRuntimeParams.
